description: Implementation of OfflineFirstUserDataRepository class managing user data preferences and analytics logging in an Android app.

classes.name: OfflineFirstUserDataRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing user data preferences with offline-first approach, integrating analytics.

methods.name: setFollowedTopicIds
methods.description: Sets the followed topic IDs in preferences.

methods.name: setTopicIdFollowed
methods.description: Marks a specific topic ID as followed or unfollowed and logs the toggle event.

methods.name: setNewsResourceBookmarked
methods.description: Bookmarks or unbookmarks a news resource and logs the action.

methods.name: setNewsResourceViewed
methods.description: Marks a news resource as viewed.

methods.name: setThemeBrand
methods.description: Sets the theme brand and logs the change.

methods.name: setDarkThemeConfig
methods.description: Configures dark theme settings and logs the change.

methods.name: setDynamicColorPreference
methods.description: Sets dynamic color preference and logs the change.

methods.name: setShouldHideOnboarding
methods.description: Hides onboarding screens and logs the change.
